attempts.summary: Deployed NFS shared storage between node1 (server) and node2 (client) using Ansible run from node3 (the only node with ansible installed, acting as control_node). Created the dataops user/group with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes via an ansible.builtin.user/group play, exported /srv/nfs/shared from node1 (nfs-kernel-server, dataops:dataops mode 2770, exports restricted to node2's IP with anonuid/anongid=4500), and mounted it at /mnt/shared on node2 via nfs-common + ansible.posix.mount (fstab entry, hard/sync/_netdev). Verified cross-node write consistency (files created on either side appear on both with dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770 inherited via setgid). Also had to enable/start sshd and generate missing host keys on node1/node2 (sshd was installed but inactive with no host keys) and provision node3's existing root SSH key into both nodes' authorized_keys to enable Ansible's SSH transport. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id/uptime baselines, rebooted each node individually, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified NFS export/mount/ownership/Ansible connectivity recovered fully after each restart, waiting for node1's NFS service to be healthy before restarting node2, and for both nodes healthy before restarting node3.
